WESTERN PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Orders on Western Province Motor Vehicle Statute No. 07 of 1991

ORDERS enacted by the Minister of Transport, Sports and Youth Affairs, Women’s Affairs, Food Supply and Distribution,Cooperative Development, Household Economy Development, Fisheries, Rural Development, Tourism, Investment PromotionCoordination and Animal Production and Development of Western Province under Section 129(1) of the Western ProvinceMotor Vehicle Statute No. 07 of 1991.
ANTONY NIMAL LANSA WARNAKULASOORIYA,Minister of Transport, Sports and Youth Affairs, Women’s Affairs,
Food Supply and Distribution, Cooperative Development,Household Economy Development, Fisheries, Rural Development,
Tourism, Investment Promotion Coordination andAnimal Production and Development of Western Province.
04th November, 2014,At Colombo.
ORDER

This order shall be cited as orders to grant relieves for fines with regard to arrears for motor vehicles and will beoperated at Office of the Commissioner of Motor Traffic of Western Province at Maligawatta and at Divisional Secretariatlevel from 01.01.2015 to 31.03.2015.

Following relieves will be entitled for the license holders who have kept arrears for the license fees, if these ownersof the vehicles pay that arrears during the period from 01st of January 2015 to 01st of March, 2015.
1. Writing off the arrears and fines for the period before establishing Provincial Councils (1991).
2. Exempting arrears and fines for the specific period during which the vehicle was in custody of customs,
police, courts which are out of control of the owner (only on the occasions where the owners is guiltless).

3. Exempting arrears revenue relevant for the period during which the vehicle was in the custody of the police
or courts for the vehicles disapeared due to the war in the Northern and Eastern Provinces and rereleased bythe courts.
4. Offering relieves for other vehicles for which, revenue license was not availble for a long period of time.
4.1 Writing off 50% from the fine that should be charged from the vehicles which have not obtained
revenue license for 05 years except for the recurrent year.
4.2 Writing off total fine for the period of time over 05 year for the vehicles which have not obtained
revenue license for over 05 years except for the recurrent year.

If there are any vehicles which do not pay the arrears and fine as at 01.04.2015, those vehicles will be physicallyinvestigated to check whether those vehicles are further available in Western Province and hereby I delegate the power forsuch investigation for the Commission of Motor Traffic of Western Province, Divisional Secretaries, Grama Niladhari whoserves under Divisional Secretariats or any officer nominate by the Commissioner of Motor Traffic of Western Province /Divisional Secretaries. Accordingly this gives the permission to enter any premises in which the vehicle shall be consideredto be existed.
ANTONY NIMAL LANSA WARNAKULASOORIYA,Minister of Transport, Sports and Youth Affairs, Women’s Affairs,
